summary.intent: Review 9 pending todos, group related ones into a GSD phase, and autonomously execute the phase (plan → code → test → PR) while the user was AFK — bundling three todos: route shared-folder writes through the SDK, remove redundant web folder-seeding post-PR#498, and encrypt share itemName at rest (Phase 14 M1 security finding).
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, researched, and fully planned (6 plans, 3 waves). Wave 1 execution began — the P0 sequence-guard fix in `loadFolder` was implemented and fixed one of two failing web-e2e specs, but `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` remains red due to a navigation race in `useFolderNavigation` (two incorrect hypotheses were ruled out before the real cause was identified). The session ended mid-diagnosis with a fix agent spawned.

repo: web-e2e runs only on push to main via `ci-e2e.yml` (the gap that let #498 land broken), but `web-e2e.yml` is directly `workflow_dispatch`-enabled — `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` runs the identical job pre-merge against any pushed branch, no CI change needed.

The GSD `phase` branching strategy (`branching_strategy: phase` in init config) creates a new branch off origin/main from the current HEAD, which can create a second parallel branch name if planning commits were already made on a differently-named branch.

Phase 47 covered owned-folder SDK consolidation (PR #494); Phase 48 is the shared-folder counterpart — `sharedFolderTree` keyed by `shareId` was decided as a sibling map (not extending `folderTree`) because shared folders carry a distinct `SharedWriteContext` and can collide on `ipnsName`.
The CRDT-IPNS-inbox todo (#2) would subsume the `itemName` encryption finding (#5) if completed, but is explicitly deferred as long-horizon research; #5 must be fixed independently.
The `UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns` duplicate-key server errors appearing in CI logs are background noise — `loadFolder`/`ensureFolderLoaded` do not register folder_ipns records at all.
TypeORM migrations for this project run via `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`; new migrations live under `apps/api/src/migrations/`.

1Password SSH commit signing can wedge mid-run with `failed to fill whole buffer` during unattended execution — unsigned commits accumulate and need re-signing or an admin merge before landing to main.

code.finding: REQ-1 fix location: `loadFolder` unconditionally called `folderTree.set()` (clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot). Guard added: skip set if existing entry has a higher or equal sequenceNumber.
`ensureFolderLoaded` short-circuit (line 422) and DFS child-check (line 454) must be left intact to avoid re-regressing #498 when adding the sequenceNumber guard.

`loadBin` treated a null return from `resolveIpnsRecord` (which also occurs on a transient post-reload cold-cache miss) as 'bin is empty' and published an empty bin record with no expectedSequenceNumber, overwriting the real record server-side. Fixed with a re-resolve guard before destructive publish — but this was NOT the root cause of the bin-restore-after-reload e2e failure.

Actual root cause of bin-restore-after-reload failure: the catch block for subfolder resolution (lines 304-307) calls `navigate('/files')`, guarded only by `latestNavTarget` (line 297). A sidebar click to `/bin` doesn't update `latestNavTarget`, so the delayed subfolder-resolve failure bounces `/bin → /files` after the user has already navigated away.
Second unconditional `navigate('/files')` call — unrelated to the bin bounce but should be audited for similar guard gaps.
Workflow is parameterized by `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}` and has `workflow_dispatch` trigger — can be dispatched against any branch ref pre-merge.
Auto-trigger is `push: branches: [main]` with paths-filter calling web-e2e via `workflow_call` — this is the main-only gate that missed the #498 regression.
BinPage only redirects on auth loss — it is NOT the source of the bin → files bounce after reload.

workflow: Playwright failure artifacts (`error-context.md` + `test-failed-N.png`) contain page ARIA snapshots and screenshots at the exact timeout moment — download these from CI artifacts before diagnosing a flaky-looking e2e failure; CI logs alone don't capture browser console output.

When two mechanism-based hypotheses both fail, the artifact (screenshot) is definitive: the failure page showed `/files` not `/bin`, which immediately falsified the 'bin data missing' hypothesis and pointed to a route bounce.
The GSD capture `--list` command with interactive todo selection can group related todos and route to phase creation in one flow — useful for consolidating work that shares a through-line.
For unattended long-running sessions, pre-agree on a signing fallback (unsigned if 1Password wedges) and a hard gate condition (stop and don't open PR if web-e2e is still red after one fix attempt).

Plan-phase checker runs as an independent subagent with adversarial posture — `depends_on` inconsistencies that the planner normalizes will still surface as warnings; distinguish blockers from warnings before rejecting plans.

friction: API stream idle timeout mid-session (initial todo analysis), requiring a full restart of the phase creation flow.
1Password SSH signer wedged with `failed to fill whole buffer` during unattended execution — all commits from the bin-fix onward are unsigned, complicating the merge path.

GSD branching strategy created a second branch (`feat/sdk-self-bootstrap-regression-fix-and-shared-folder-metadata`) off HEAD, leaving the original planning branch (`feat/phase-48-sdk-self-bootstrap-fix-and-shares`) as a dangling pointer to just the first commit — required manual verification that no work was orphaned.

Two incorrect root-cause hypotheses for `bin-restore-after-reload.spec.ts` were pursued and committed before the actual navigation-race cause was found — the bin-clobber fix (`loadBin` empty-publish guard) was merged to the branch but did not fix the e2e failure.
CI logs from GitHub Actions don't include browser console output, requiring a full Playwright artifact download to get the page snapshot needed for real diagnosis.
Shell glob quoting issues when using `find` with patterns containing hyphens caused one command failure requiring a retry.
